name: What are the biggest mistakes in luxury remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What are the most common mistakes people make on high-end remodels?
mainEntity.text: What are the most common mistakes people make on high-end remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: High-end remodeling mistakes are often expensive because the project involves custom work and premium materials. A common error is starting construction before the design is fully resolved, which leads to change orders and delays. Another is choosing a contractor based only on the lowest bid without comparing scope, allowances, and exclusions. Homeowners also underestimate how much hidden conditions can affect older homes, especially when walls are opened. Delaying finish selections is another frequent problem because custom cabinetry, tile, stone, and appliances can have long lead times. Ignoring the permitting process can also derail a project once work begins. The most successful luxury remodels have a clear plan, a realistic budget, and a team that communicates early and often. Avoiding those mistakes usually matters more than chasing the cheapest price or the fastest schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest mistakes are rushing design, underestimating costs, choosing finishes before the plan is complete, ignoring permitting, and hiring based only on price. Another common mistake is not budgeting for hidden conditions in older homes. Luxury projects need clear scope, enough time, and careful coordination.
